entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could you provide me with the order number?
VF789-0014. It's for the cycling shoes.
Got it, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
They don't work. I keep getting blisters.

I'm sorry to hear that. Discomfort is definitely not what we aim for. Was there any specific issue with adjusting the cleats, or was it just the overall fit of the cycling shoes that was causing the problem?
The fit. They just don't fit. I want a refund.
Understood. Let me just confirm the delivery date... It looks like you received these 72 days ago. I'm checking our return policy now.
Yes, I can help with that. Our policy allows for returns on standard items up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're within that window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you.
Fine. Whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
